scope: Checked replay for one unchanged solid HATCH and one closed, straight LWPOLYLINE in bounded ASCII AC1024 model space.
checks: Bind physical source bytes, source owner, geometry and reciprocal handles; require a simple integer contour and revalidate live identities and geometry at section boundaries and finalization.

Compose the staged HEADER, TABLES, BLOCKS, ENTITIES and OBJECTS isolation checks with existing image and material observers. Changes detected before finalization refuse atomically; corrected retries succeed.

A second save after reopen preserves the association and reciprocal reactor. Non-admitted versions, profiles and selected unrelated object families retain deassociation; an existing fixed-structural-handle collision still fails safely.

System codec: 957 assertions in 7 focused cases, including material/image coexistence, geometry and identity late mutation, destination preservation and retry. Bundled codec: 203 assertions in 3 focused cases.

Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 audits found matching reciprocal references and model-space ownership with zero errors/fixes in three locally authored outputs and their ODA File Converter 27.1.0 conversions. No DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
limits: At most 64 KiB source capture; one solid straight loop, integral coordinates bounded by one million, at most 4096 edges, and the exact known source/output graph profile.

This does not qualify edits to the loop, general HATCH associations, arbitrary object graphs, native GUI behavior or other producers. Later unqualified metadata changes may still cause safe transactional refusal.
